Name: Twice Wedding in the Chruch English
Author: Sarventee
Description:
This mod allows you to get married in church, supports the original role and any extended NPC, as long as he can produce romantic marriage rather than roommate relationship, and supports same-sex marriage.
However, because the original wedding cannot be covered, you can only use this mod after marriage, and you must use it after marriage!
Do not use this mod before marriage, or you can change the config to false, otherwise there will be vicious bugs
This is an incomplete mod that may contain bugs
You will wake up the next day and go to church to attend a humble wedding presided over by priests angels, because my literary skills are very poor.
This priest angel can get married, but my original intention is that he is just a master of ceremonies. So he has no events and will not go to festivals and movies.
It's ok if you have to marry him, but it'll be boring. Because there are no events of any kind.
This church is usually inaccessible, but you can talk to angels.
This is the tip of the iceberg of mod night city that I am making. This large-scale extended mod will include 35 new NPCs, more than 200 maps and a lot of plots.
Please look forward to it. I've finished most of it.
If you are interested in night city, you can join QQ group 765685589
